summary: This directory provides an abstraction layer for interacting with web page content, enabling the representation, navigation, and structured querying of HTML elements and their attributes within a parsed document context.
responsibilities: Representing web pages as queryable document structures
Wrapping and extending DOM elements for simplified traversal
Providing type-safe access to element properties and attributes
Parsing raw HTML or response data into structured objects
relationships: The Page structure acts as the container for DOM elements, enabling navigation across the document.
DOM elements encapsulate specific HTML tags and hold collections of attribute objects.
Parsing mechanisms use configuration options to transform raw content into a structured Page instance.
designDecisions: Wrapper pattern for extending native DOM functionality
Type-safe generic implementation for element specific operations
Factory-like initialization patterns for page creation from various data sources
